about_the_game:
On a quiet night, the protagonist heads out to visit his friend, Sugimoto.
As usual, he takes out his phone and sends a message.

“I’m coming over.”

It should have been a normal visit —
nothing more than that.

The Message: I’m Coming Over is a first-person horror adventure told through smartphone chats.

You play as the protagonist, walking through the city at night while staying in contact with Sugimoto, following his messages as you make your way toward his apartment.

Unfamiliar shortcuts.
Events you shouldn’t know about.
And encounters with things that should not exist.

Guided by Sugimoto’s knowledge of the occult,
you must avoid — or sometimes confront — these strange phenomena as you continue through the night.

Will you stop?
Will you run?
Or will you trust his words and keep going?

Memories of death and loss slowly resurface.
And Sugimoto’s room draws closer with every step.

When you finally arrive,
will it truly be your friend waiting for you —
or something else entirely?

Horror Beyond the Chat Screen

  • Conversations unfold through a smartphone-style interface

  • Ordinary exchanges slowly distort reality

A Familiar City That Becomes Strange

  • Set in an urban neighborhood

  • The streets you know transform into an unsettling maze

Conversations Shape Your Fate

  • Salvation or destruction

  • Your choices determine the ending

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains intense horror sequences and unsettling imagery.
It may not be suitable for players who are disturbed by horror or grotesque content.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later (Intel or Apple Silicon)
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5-8259U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / Intel Iris Plus 655
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in macOS compatible sound device
mac_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later (Intel or Apple Silicon)
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro or better / Intel Core i7-9750H or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro GPU or better / AMD Radeon Pro 5500M or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in macOS compatible sound device

short_description: On a quiet night, you text your friend Sugimoto: “I’m on my way.” This first-person horror adventure unfolds through smartphone chats. Walk the city at night, face strange encounters, and make choices that lead you to his room. Can you trust the words on your screen?
